hero.title: One group, five pillars, a single standard.
hero.intro: Glob 3X Group is a family of companies that develop, build, equip and operate. Each project on this website lists exactly which role we played.

manifesto.title: Builders first.
body: Glob 3X started on site, not in a sales office. In 2008 the company began building multi-storey residential buildings in Tirana, acting as developer and construction company at the same time. That double role is still what defines us: we sell what we build, and we build what we sell.

In 2014 Glob 3X Construction took more than 820 Albanian workers to Russia for the Sochi Winter Olympics construction programme: the Olympic stadium, the Sochi railway station, tourist complexes, social and cultural buildings, the auxiliary buildings of the Adler stadium and resorts in Krasnaya Polyana. Later came construction works on Skopje East Gate in North Macedonia.

Today the group develops residences across Tirana, operates a scaffolding and site-equipment company, prepares its first hotel, and co-develops Reeds Towers, the tallest project in its history and one of the tallest ever approved in Tirana.

reeds-towers.name: Reeds Towers
reeds-towers.tagline: Where the vision touches the sky.
reeds-towers.intro: Two towers of 55 and 36 floors rising 191.89 metres above Kavaja Street, designed by Coldefy (Paris) with Artech Studio (Tirana), landscape by Sempervirens and engineering by HMS. Approved by the National Territory Council, decision No. 28 of 18 April 2025.
body: Reeds Towers grows directly out of the ground, in symbiosis with nature and the sky. A total built area of 83,576 m² brings together residences, a hotel, offices, retail and a sky restaurant on floors 48 to 54, around a public plaza shaded by a sculptural white metal canopy.

Residences range from 1+1 apartments from about 57 m² to 2+1 apartments of about 101 m², with curved glass façades, movable panels and terraces that open towards the city centre and the mountains around Tirana.
Glob 3X Group co-develops the project with Lojbi Construction. Reeds Towers has its own sales team and a dedicated website with the full brochure, plans and film.

facts.label: Programme
facts.value: Residences, hotel (floors 3–5), offices, retail, sky restaurant (floors 48–54)

glow-tower.name: Glow Tower
glow-tower.tagline: A 25-storey landmark for the New Boulevard.
glow-tower.intro: Concept for a 25-floor mixed-use tower with six underground levels on Tirana's New Boulevard: hotel, apartments, offices and retail stacked around a planted garden court.
body: Glow Tower is the group's second tower project, developed as a concept while Reeds Towers advances. The slender volume reads as a stack of lit bands, hence the name, and sets a hotel and offices on the lower floors with apartments above, all looking towards the mountains.
A garden courtyard, a double-height lobby and a restaurant anchor the ground floor on the New Boulevard, the axis that is becoming Tirana's new business district.

lorden-residence.name: Lorden Residence
lorden-residence.tagline: Eighty homes, an inner park, 1.6 km from Skanderbeg Square.
lorden-residence.intro: A residential building of 6 and 7 floors with two underground levels on Ramazan Bogdani Street, developed and built by Glob 3X. Apartments now selling directly from the developer.
body: Lorden Residence sits 1.6 km from Skanderbeg Square with excellent connections to the centre of Tirana. The seven-storey residence comprises 80 apartments, more than 1,300 m² of commercial space and 100 parking spaces.

Surrounded by streets on all sides and organised around an internal park, Lorden combines elegance with everyday comfort: thermal and acoustic insulation, modern systems and recreational space for residents.

new-corner-residence.name: New Corner Residence
new-corner-residence.tagline: An architectural gem in the Grimshaw master-plan zone.
new-corner-residence.intro: A completed residence of 6 residential floors and 1 service floor with two underground parking levels on Besa Street, in the zone planned by Grimshaw Architects next to the New Boulevard. A ground-floor commercial unit of 77.5 m² is for sale.
body: New Corner Residence was built in one of the most important development areas of Tirana, the district master-planned by the British practice Grimshaw Architects beside the New Boulevard. Six residential floors and one service floor define modern living in the heart of the city.

With two levels of underground parking, the complex combines convenience with sophistication. Carefully integrated recreational space offers a quiet oasis in the middle of the pulsing city. Home, services or easy access to the centre: New Corner has it all.
Available now: a ground-floor commercial unit of 77.5 m² with east–west orientation.

Sales for the service spaces open soon. Register your interest and our agents will contact you first.

hotel-varosh.name: Hotel Varosh
hotel-varosh.intro: A two-storey hotel and restaurant with one underground level and an outdoor pool in Varosh, on the green edge of Tirana. In development.
body: Hotel Varosh marks the group's entry into hospitality: a low, horizontal building with a restaurant, pool terrace and rooms opening onto the landscape, a short drive from the centre of Tirana.
The experience gained here feeds directly into the hotel floors and sky restaurant of Reeds Towers.

skopje-east-gate.name: Skopje East Gate
skopje-east-gate.tagline: Construction works on one of the region's largest developments.
skopje-east-gate.intro: Glob 3X Construction took part in the construction programme of East Gate in Skopje, one of the largest retail-led mixed-use developments in North Macedonia.
body: On the East Gate site, Glob 3X crews worked on the reinforced-concrete structure of the complex alongside tower cranes and concrete-pumping fleets, applying the site organisation first proven on the Sochi programme.
The project confirmed the group's ability to mobilise large teams across borders and to work inside the programmes of major regional developers.

sochi-2014.name: Sochi 2014
sochi-2014.tagline: 820 workers, six site types, one Olympic deadline.
sochi-2014.intro: In 2014 Glob 3X Construction took part in the construction programme of the Sochi Winter Olympics with more than 820 workers from Albania.
body: The Olympic programme was the group's first large international mobilisation. Albanian crews worked on the Olympic stadium in Sochi, the Sochi railway station, tourist complexes, social and cultural buildings, the auxiliary buildings of the Adler stadium and the resorts of Krasnaya Polyana.
Delivering on the Olympic calendar, with its fixed opening date, shaped the way Glob 3X plans and runs every site since.
